subject: general
question: Which of the following has the highest velocity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Light**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The speed of light in the air is 3 × 10⁸ m/s.

 
 
• The speed of light in a vacuum is 186,282 miles per second (299,792 kilometres per second).
 
• In theory, nothing can travel faster than light. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cosmic rays**:

 
 
• They are high energy particles that move through space at nearly the speed of light.
 
 
 
• **Supersonic speed**:
 
 
• If the speed of an object exceeds the speed of sound (Mach 1) then it is referred as supersonic speed.
